title: Aerated grit chamber design criteria (WEF MOP 11)
markdown:
| Parameter (editorial; no printed header) | Value (editorial; no printed header) |
| --- | --- |
| Transverse velocity at surface | 0.6-0.8 m/s |
| Depth-to-width ratio | 1.5:1 to 2:1 |
| Air supply | 4.6-7.7 l/m/s of length |
| Air supply | 0.3-0.4 m3 /m3 |
| Detention time | 3-5 min (peak) |
| Quantity of grit | 7.5-75 ml/m3 |
| Quantity of scum (skimmings) | 7.5-45 ml/m3 |
notes: The source prints these criteria as an unruled two-column list with no caption, no table number and no column headings; both headers above are editorial column descriptors. Tp342-1 is a service locator, not a printed table number.
The air supply parameter has two printed values on consecutive lines with the label printed once; the label is repeated here for the two logical rows and the merge is recorded in cell_spans.
Introduced by the printed sentence: The aerated de gritting removals are reproduced from WEF MOP 11 hereunder.
Superscripts in the printed units are serialized as m3 and ml/m3: 0.3-0.4 m3 /m3, 7.5-75 ml/m3 and 7.5-45 ml/m3.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs, plus enlarged crops at 288-720 dpi and a contact sheet of every hashed source region; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First visual transcription only. Every printed glyph, power, subscript, inequality, unit, hyphen spacing, footnote and printed error was read from the rendered source and retained or flagged; no value inferred.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every coefficient, power, subscript and cell against 144-dpi region renders, with 400-dpi zoom where needed.
